prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Pleasanton CA for a checkup and cleaning?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single universally “best” dentist — the right one depends on your needs (insurance, location, comfort level, whether you want a family-friendly office, etc.). I can help you find the best fit for a routine checkup and cleaning in Pleasanton. Here’s a quick, practical way to find a great dentist plus what to look for and some follow-up help I can provide.

How to find top dentists in Pleasanton
- Search Google Maps or Yelp for “dentist Pleasanton” and sort by rating + number of reviews (aim for 4.5+ with many reviews).
- Use Zocdoc or Healthgrades to see patient reviews and availability.
- Check the California Dental Board license lookup to confirm the dentist’s license and any disciplinary history.
- Ask friends, family, coworkers, or your primary care provider for personal referrals.

What to look for for a checkup & cleaning
- General dentist/primary care dentist (not necessarily a specialist).
- Hygienist experience and patient comfort (gentle cleanings).
- Up-to-date infection-control policies and modern equipment (digital X‑rays, intraoral camera).
- Accepts your dental insurance or offers transparent pricing for uninsured patients.
- Good patient reviews that specifically mention cleanings, gentle care, and punctual appointments.
- Convenient hours and location.

Questions to ask when calling or booking
- Do you accept my insurance (name the plan)? What will my co-pay be for an exam/cleaning?
- How long is a routine cleaning appointment?
- Who performs the cleaning — the dentist or a hygienist? How experienced are they?
- Do you take X‑rays at the first visit? What’s the cost if not covered by insurance?
- What is your cancellation/no-show policy?
- If I have dental anxiety, what options do you offer for comfort/sedation?

Typical cost (ballpark)
- Routine exam + cleaning with X‑rays: often $100–$250 out of pocket if uninsured. Prices vary a lot.

If you want, I can:
- Narrow the search for you if you tell me your insurance, exact Pleasanton neighborhood or ZIP code, whether this is for an adult or child, and any other preferences (evenings, Spanish-speaking staff, sedation).
- Draft a short script or message to call/email clinics to check availability and prices.

Which would you like me to do next?
